note: G8 M4: the Q of a mill G73 is a peck depth, not a block number — the code database declares it as one. The profile's G7[0-3] P/Q rule is a lathe rule, and it used to fire on every chip-break peck cycle, which taught users to click through the one dialog that protects them. It now needs both P and Q, as the lathe cycles have.
